children: Epic Gold reports a Benoist estimate of 150,700 indicated ounces at 2.26 g/t Au and 86,900 inferred ounces at 1.67 g/t Au. It supersedes the 2020 estimate, but the two estimates are not directly comparable.
Adds an indicated resource category, providing greater confidence in this portion of the reported resource.
Inferred ounces have lower confidence; planned infill drilling may test whether portions can be upgraded.
Gold-only 1.2 g/t cut-off; no study completed
The estimate uses conceptual underground constraints and does not establish economic viability.
Changes in drilling, modeling, assumptions and reporting criteria prevent treating the figures as resource growth.
Infill and deeper drilling are planned
Future drilling results could test resource conversion and expansion, but no results are disclosed here.

This is an updated resource disclosure for an exploration-stage project, with the company stating that the 2026 and 2020 estimates are not directly comparable. Subsequent infill and deeper drilling results, plus a technical report expected within 45 days, would provide the next evidence on resource confidence and potential expansion.
